description: Prefill the Search Bar Typing Animation Maker: a search bar animation: a query typed letter by letter, then the search button pressed. Returns a link that opens the Tool with these options; the user presses Export there to download the video. All options are optional. Icons, images and audio that need a file upload are not supported. Here the built-in key and click sounds work, and so does the results page. Your own key or click sound is added on the Tool's page: open the link and upload it there (it stays in the browser).

accent.description: Accent color of the search button. Default: "#2563eb".

box.description: Shape of the search bar: pill, flat, outlined or 3d. Default: "pill".

cam.description: The camera: off, or follow (zooms on the letter being typed, then out at the press). Default: "off".

click.description: Sound played on the button press; "off" for silence. Default: "mouse".

cps.description: Typing speed in characters per second. Default: 8.

font.description: Font id of the text. Default: "inter".

gap.description: Seconds a finished query stays after its press before the next query starts. Default: 1.

hold.description: Seconds the final frame holds at the end. Default: 1.

keys.description: Sound played at every letter; "off" for silence. Default: "laptop".

lead.description: Seconds of empty search bar before typing starts. Default: 1.

look.description: Light or dark search bar style. Default: "light".

pause.description: Seconds between finishing typing and pressing the button. Default: 0.5.

ph.description: Faint placeholder text in the empty search bar before typing; blank for none. Default: "".

press.description: Whether the search button is pressed after typing: 1 yes, 0 no. Default: true.

q.description: The search query that gets typed. Default: "how to make a video intro".

q2.description: Search query number 2, typed after the one before; blank to leave it out. Default: "".

q3.description: Search query number 3, typed after the one before; blank to leave it out. Default: "".

q4.description: Search query number 4, typed after the one before; blank to leave it out. Default: "".

q5.description: Search query number 5, typed after the one before; blank to leave it out. Default: "".

results.description: Whether a simple results page follows the press: 1 yes, 0 no. Default: true.

rhythm.description: even: every letter takes the same time; natural: a human-like jitter between letters. Default: "even".

s1_1.description: Suggestion line 1 shown under the search bar while query 1 is typed; blank to leave it out. Default: "".
